subject.title: Refactor hot TypeScript modules and enforce the LOC ratchet

question: Should this remain one coordinated maintenance program while implementation is split into independently reviewable module refactors and a separate LOC-ratchet change?
rationale: The objective is aligned, but sequencing and ownership across Gateway, embedded-runner, transport, and CI boundaries determine reviewability and regression risk.

options.title: Stage focused PRs
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require separate PRs for each hot module plus the LOC-ratchet integration, each with focused behavior proof.

options.title: Ratchet first
options.body: Land only the baseline and CI ratchet initially, then schedule the three refactors independently as capacity permits.

options.title: Defer the program
options.body: Leave the existing checker and modules unchanged until maintainers can sponsor ownership and broad regression validation.

recommendation.title: Stage focused PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require separate PRs for each hot module plus the LOC-ratchet integration, each with focused behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue sponsor also has relevant merged history across the OpenAI transport, Gateway, and embedded-runner surfaces.
